page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4g.8xlarge is a member of the Local SSDs instance family, configured for workloads requiring direct high-throughput disk access alongside balanced compute resources. The system is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz, delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs managed through the KVM hypervisor.

The hardware configuration pairs these 32 dedicated cores with 128.0 GB of system memory, matching a balanced general-purpose allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage architecture features a dedicated 1919 GB local SSD directly attached to the instance, removing network disk latency for hot data tiers. Networking performance provides a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The instance does not feature dedicated GPU accelerators and provisions zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its combination of dedicated processor execution, balanced memory distribution, and bundled high-capacity local solid-state storage, this server provides qualitative cost efficiencies for storage-centric operations by reducing dependency on external block storage volumes. Tradeoffs include the non-persistent nature typical of local SSD disks compared to replicated cloud storage. It is suitable for high-performance transactional database engines, distributed NoSQL stores, search index nodes, caching clusters, and data processing pipelines.
